title: Chapter 517
paragraphs: Chapter 517
Episode 142. Negotiations (3)
Tikan was still under heavy construction. The massive equipment from Heukwang Mine was being completely modified and relocated, so it was bound to take time.
However, even though the construction was not yet complete, Tikan had already achieved more than 80% of the defense capabilities of the old Heukwang Mine.

Purely considering the defensive capabilities of the equipment brought from Heukwang Mine, it was 80%. When considering the power of Jin's existing colleagues and the newly joined allies (though they thought of them as subordinates), Tikan was no different from the single most powerful city in history, excluding the two major forces.

There was no place among the existing medium and small countries that could surpass Tikan. From the moment when the Ghost Army and the Heukwang Unit joined, Tikan had become a land that could be called the 5th power without any problem.
"Ah, the proclamation of a nation is just around the corner..."
Perhaps for that reason, this man, Gwi-geom Kashmir Alfrien, the owner of Tikan, the leader of the Chilsaekjo, and a thorough mysticist who is misunderstood, had become increasingly teary lately.

The indescribable feelings of gratitude, the sensitivity that had become especially delicate as he entered his 40s, the certainty that the long-awaited aspiration would soon come to an end and start anew, and the gratitude for his colleagues were the reasons for Kashmir's tears of happiness.
"Oh, our Kashmir is crying again."
"Yuria, get your dad a handkerchief. What a disgrace when Jin is here?"
"Why are you crying, Kashmir?"
Jet, Alisa, and Amela spoke.
It had been a long time since all the colleagues gathered to eat together. Everyone except Gilly, who had gone for a walk together with Murakan's persistence, was sitting at the table.
"It's still not enough to declare a nation."
Jin said.
He too wasn't without gratitude in his heart. However, after returning from this mission, a sense of urgency had naturally entered Jin's mind once again.
"You're right, it's still not enough. The possibility of Zipfel and Kinzelo attacking this place in a short time is low, but they will try to put pressure whenever they have a chance."
As Lata spoke, Valkas nodded.
"The installation of fortress defense equipment is slower than expected, my lord."
"I heard it's because the equipment was optimized for the mountains where Heukwang Mine was located, Valkas."

"That's right. The compatibility with Tikan is not too bad, but it's not perfect. And I've felt this since Heukwang Mine, but our equipment has a lot of room for improvement. In fact, thanks to Amela, a lot of improvements have already been made."
Amela.
As she demonstrated in the Gaipa Military District, she is a master of war using the power of chaos.
In the Gaipa Military District, she showed even more powerful strength than usual, fused with Bubare's chaos, but even without that, she was the world's best war equipment operator.
If Valkas is about 'war,' then she alone is better than the entire Heukwang Unit, as he evaluates.

"Even though not all the equipment has been installed yet, it's at 80% of its power because of that reason. But watching Amella enhance the equipment, I realized that it can still get better. We can achieve even more than the power of the old Black King's group."
"Is that possible?"
"Definitely, my lord!"
Amella pulled her hand out from the bushy clothes and waved it as she spoke.

Jin felt she was somewhat awkward. They had fought fiercely in the Gaipa Military District, and after Yona's verification was over, Amella had fainted, so they hadn't exchanged a word before going to the Sota Desert.

On the other hand, Amella, following Valkas and Lata, called Jin "my lord" and acted very friendly. That was because her chaos had been defeated by Yona, and she had an inherently friendly personality. It seemed like her fear of Jin and Murakan had also disappeared.

"Most of Valkas's equipment is the product of modern magical engineering. However, some are relics, commonly called masterpieces, like your helmet, my lord. Valkas didn't seem to know much about them, our little cuties."

Before meeting Jin, Amella had wandered the world with Chaos as a mercenary and explorer for her entire life. As a result, there were few people in the world more knowledgeable about relics and artifacts than her.
"Hehe, I can't believe I'm being called an old man by someone my age."
"Hey, don't call me a cutie...!"
Amella's appearance, hidden by the bushes, looked even younger than Enya, so Valkas felt somewhat hurt. Lata and Fey reacted strongly to being called "cutie."
"Masterpiece?"

"It was probably made by demons or the old Zipfel people. For example, the thing Valkas calls Black King Cannon No. 1, I think it should be called the Magic-absorbing, All-weather, Accelerating Crusher Cannon. Valkas didn't know that, so he used it as a regular cannon."
"Magic-absorbing... what? Wow, our Amella knows how to use such difficult words. Did you understand, my lord?"
"Magic-absorbing, All-weather, Accelerating Crusher Cannon...?"
Jin, who always had academy critiques with him, was quite familiar with such long, formal names.
"Ha, as expected of my lord."
"If we find all of its functions, it'll be the strongest cannon in existence. Hmm... as a comparison, it's probably stronger than the Magic-infusing, All-weather, Crushing Cannon of Kojak."
It seemed that just comparing the slightly different names, the former would be stronger. However, it was unclear whether Amella's words were really true.

"If that's true, how did that thing end up in the Black King's Mine? During the time when the Black King's group existed independently, they often interacted with Zipfel and Royal Engineers for equipment maintenance. There's no way they would have left that magic... whatever cannon alone."

"Cutie's questions are cute as well. Do you think they would send their top personnel to the Black King's group? They only sent some mediocre people, so maybe they didn't know? It's a problem that can be solved with a little bit of thought."
"That's true."
"Uhuh, cutie is an Amella fan!"
"Wow, anyway, it's an amazing cannon, right? Can Amella restore it?"
In response to Enya's question, Amella shook her head. Due to being caught by Lata, her neck could hardly move, so it looked like she was just shaking the bushes.
"No, uh, that, aaah, I, can't do it. Ah, bone, bone, it hit! Hold on! My ability is not enough. And I don't even know if there's anyone in the world who can restore it."

"Master, whether Amella's words are true or not. It seems necessary to recruit a proper magical engineer. Even if it's not the Black King Cannon No. 1, there are many pieces of equipment to improve, and more importantly. We have to find clues about the mechanical device we obtained from the Sota Desert."
An item that could change the course of the upcoming war.
The prophet described the machine Jin had acquired to Rosa in that way.
'Mother didn't hear the exact purpose of that item from the prophet. If she had, she would have told me, as it would definitely benefit the family.'
Of course, the prophet's words could be false. He may not even know the purpose of the machine.
But since it was not there for no reason along with the blueprints, it was necessary to find out why.
In order to do that, the help of a genius magical engineer was needed along with Hister's record magic.
"Jet."
"Yes, Master!"
"Let me know immediately if Aria contacts you."
He had not met Valeria since he left the Wantaralom Forest last year and spent time with Yona.
She had the corpse of the Vermont Mine found in Wantaralom Forest as evidence to pressure the royal family later.

She was also analyzing the ironwork of Kinzelo, which Jin had obtained from the Sword Emperor Castle, and the record devices Jin had given her, and was in the process of restoring Hister's magic and tracking down Temar's tomb.
The lack of contact was either because there were no results yet or because she was exposed to some danger. It must be one of the two.
'If not, she has entered the next inherited territory.'
Along with Valeria, Misha was also out of contact, making Jin feel a little uneasy.
"Of course. Oh, don't worry too much, no news is good news. Although the contact is very rare, is there anything wrong with that ambitious lady?"
"I hope so. Hey, Murakan. Misha..."
"Master, Murakan went for a walk with Gilly... Ah, there they are! Huh? But why are they riding a giant toad... Talaris Knight's Eye Toad Mort?"
The Seven Swords of the Nonet, Ryu and Hiten, who were sitting at the dining table, suddenly stood up and saluted.
"Greetings to the Palace Master!"
"Greetings to the Palace Master!"
Not only Murakan and Gilly were riding the Eye Toad Mort, but their owners were also on board.
For some reason, Kuzan, Veris, and Yulian were standing next to them with blank faces as if they had become some kind of apprentices.
"Ugh, son-in-law. It's been a while!"
"Welcome, Talaris and Syris."
"How come my son-in-law never calls his mother-in-law when such an occasion arises?"
"Did you not receive an invitation from Lukas Manfran?"

"Ah, it seems we missed each other. I almost got upset again, huh? Hahaha... Ha! I was so surprised. On the way here, I heard from this handsome Black Dragon brother that some strange thing had clung to our son-in-law."
It was about Sandra Zipfel.
At that, Syris sighed as if she had no strength to argue with her mother anymore.
"Son-in-law wouldn't have feelings for the young lady of a hostile family, right?"
"Mother, although she is a Zipfel, she has been a great help to Jin."
"Ugh, he's so rigid. Can't you take a joke?"
"It must not have been a light will."
Syris, of course, absolutely, did not have any feelings for Sandra Zipfel.
But she felt a strange feeling about the fact that Sandra, who was a friend, had helped Jin to the point of betraying the Nonet, something she herself couldn't do.
'If it had been the old me, I would have just sneered at how stupid and foolish I could be. It seems meeting Jin has changed me a bit too.'
Talaris shrugged her shoulders.
"Well, I'm grateful too. But scolding your mother in front of everyone like this. I'm still the master of the Nonet."
"I apologize for that, Mother."
"Hehehe, that was a joke just now. Don't be so tense!"
"Ah, really."

"Anyway, our daughter is fun to tease. Anyway, nice to see everyone. Seeing the three generations of mercenaries gathered, eating, and laughing together is a bit strange. The charm of the man I picked as my son-in-law... So, what were you all talking about?"
"Magic absorption spray-type all-weather acceleration..."
As Jin answered up to that point.
Suddenly, an alarm sounded throughout Tikan. It was the equipment installed by the Black King's group that was raising the alarm.
Waaaaaaaaa-!
The alarm started due to an unidentified object suddenly appearing in the sky. And the protagonist who caused the alarm was the person who had escorted Jin's party in the Sota Desert not long ago.
It was Zephyrin.
